what_happened: Scene L9/S9. A different strategy: the sponge was grasped first at 121 and carried over the sink, where it briefly counted as inside at 154-156. It was then placed ON the pan still on the counter, at 319 (0.26 m from the basin). The pan (pan_4) was then grasped by the handle at 442 with the sponge inside, carried, and released at 522 slightly above the basin (dropped 10 cm). Both landed inside: stage 0 at 525, stage 1 at 530. Stage 2: contact with the stub lever from above, 770-865; success at 867 (97 steps of contact).
official_criterion_notes: Stage 0 is only credited at 525 because the sponge's first release (319) was on the pan on the counter. Stage durations (525 / 5) are artefacts of the order-free counting, not slowness.
